newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-INDIA'S GANGULY INJURED IN PRACTICE.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-INDIA'S GANGULY INJURED IN PRACTICE.

text.p: Indian batsman Saurav Ganguly was injured in practice on Monday and could miss Tuesday's Titan Cup match against South Africa, team captain Sachin Tendulkar said.
Ganguly was hit on the left calf by a powerful shot from team mate Javagal Srinath during nets and sat down in considerable pain, clutching his leg.
"It's a sad blow but we can only take a decision (on his inclusion) tomorrow," Tendulkar said.
